reasons.plausibility: This aligns well with established mechanisms in high-entropy alloys where lattice distortion and short-range order inhibit dislocation motion, thus enhancing strength.
reasons.testability: Systematic compositional variations combined with XRD, APT, and mechanical testing are clearly outlined, though accurate measurement of short-range order can be technically demanding.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a direct and well-defined experimental roadmap to clarify the origins of enhanced hardness and strength in HEAs.
